ResearchProjectDef.label: directed chassis gestation
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A sealed-file technique for growing an artificial military organism rather than printing a mech. A directed development sequence is written into an embryo, whose mesonuclear substrate then builds synthetic-mechanical structure in place of tissue and matures on its own. The embryo is brought to term in a growth vat, or in a human surrogate where no vat is available.

AMO development was halted permanently after a catastrophic incident in the Earth era, and the technology has been proscribed ever since. The stated grounds are the damage a self-developing organism does to local society and industry. The colonial fleets enforce the ban themselves rather than through local authorities. A world found running a production chain is not fined or licensed. It is burned back to the ore.

Unlocks the XM132 Frogman and its development sequence.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Researchers have decoded a sealed expeditional file containing the XM132 development sequence, the earliest artificial military organism on human record.

The Frogman can now be produced. Gestate an embryo at an artifuscle chamber, then bring it to term in a growth vat or a surrogate. The result is a biomatroid larva. Protect its gestation pod for five days and it will mature into a dormant frogman.

The file carries a fleet prohibition notice. AMO production is proscribed on any settled world, and the fleets enforce it in person. Outside the fleets, only decoded files and fleet deviants have ever produced one.

ResearchProjectDef.label: enclosed assault frame
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A load-bearing frame anchored directly into the pilot's skeleton, driven by artificial muscle bundles that only draw at full closure. It allows a single soldier to carry and operate armament far beyond their own muscular limit. Because closure is a precondition of output, the device cannot be released by any conventional means once sealed, and separation of the pilot must be performed surgically.
This inability to self-release classifies the device, under the laws of war, as restraining equipment upon its own pilot. The positive applications of its skeletal anchoring and load-transfer principles to prosthetic rehabilitation are nonetheless equally present.

Approved by ███████ and ███, the enclosed assault frame and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterTitle: Sealed file I: enclosed assault frame
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Researchers have opened a class I sealed file containing an early prototype of the bionic suit.

The heavy bionic suit can now be assembled at an artifuscle chamber. It occupies every layer over the torso and lets its pilot carry and fight with weapons no unaided soldier could handle.

It only works fully closed. Once a pilot is sealed into one it is no longer clothing: it cannot be removed by normal means, and cannot be stripped from anyone still alive. Removal is surgery.

The fleets sealed this file for a reason. Fielding it openly will be noted.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cluster command
ResearchProjectDef.description: A facility-scale computer assembled from arrays of microelectronic chips and the power system that drives them. Even a bare mainframe with no attached subsystems commands and coordinates mechs as capably as a human mechanitor. Technology of this kind was already in wide use in humanity's wars against itself long before it reached the stars, and after the expansion it was deployed in bulk on interstellar terraforming programs, bringing countless barren worlds to life.\n\nApproved by ████ and ██, cluster command and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Provision of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and outside emergency war mobilization, standing ground-force deployments are to avoid employing it in any military operation.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Researchers have opened a class I sealed file containing the architecture of a cluster command mainframe.

The central command core can now be built. A single core directs mechs across the entire map without a mechanitor, supplying its own control bandwidth and command groups.

The fleets keep this file sealed for standing armies and open it only for emergency mobilization. Fielding it in a routine ground deployment will be noted.

ResearchProjectDef.label: synthetic biology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cultured strains built from the ground up, engineered to reassemble simple nutrients and mineral feedstock into complex organic macromolecules. They synthesize neutroamine, edible artiprotein and comparable organic polymers at far higher efficiency than any conventional process, and require neither fields nor livestock to do it.\n\nApproved by █████ and ███, synthetic biology and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Provision of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and derived biosynthesis lines are to be operated only within orbital installations and fleet supply nodes.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Researchers have opened a class I sealed file containing the gene maps and metabolic pathways of a set of engineered culture strains.

Artiprotein can now be refined from crops in a reaction chamber, and neutroamine synthesized from meat and chemfuel. The artifuscle chamber can also grow artificial muscle from artiprotein and tungsteel, with no gold or neutroamine required.

The fleets did not seal this file over weapons. A colony that synthesizes its own protein and drug precursors stops buying them from anyone. Running these lines will be noted.
